定位到两个具体问题：

1. 截图里的文字是 **“More reactions”**，意思是“更多表情回应”。代码把它作为消息下方的普通按钮显示，所以看起来像消息内容，干扰阅读。建议改为悬停或键盘聚焦消息时出现的“添加回应”图标；已有回应才在消息下方显示表情和人数。
2. 两个相机图标实际上分别是**截图**和**拍照**，并非两个拍照功能。截图使用相机图标造成了误导，应改为截图选框图标。

成熟 IM 的共性是把附件能力集中在一个入口：[Slack](https://slack.com/help/articles/201330736-Add-files-to-Slack) 和 [Signal](https://support.signal.org/hc/en-us/articles/360038443071-View-Once-Media) 都通过附件入口选择文件或媒体。拍照和选照片可以放在同一个菜单里，但菜单内应明确区分。

我建议采用这套方案：

- 展开工具栏保留 **截图｜附件｜表情**，统一图标尺寸、按钮间距、悬停提示和焦点样式。
- “附件”菜单提供 **照片、拍照、文件、文件夹**，每项同时显示图标和文字。
- 截图继续保留独立快捷入口，适合桌面聊天。
- 消息下方取消常驻的 “More reactions” 文字按钮，保留已有回应；添加回应移入消息操作栏。

是否按这套方案实施？

联系人列表为什么又有按钮又可以右键弹出菜单，是不是重复交互，应该要可以合并吧：[Image #1]

是的，**如果两者提供相同操作，就应共用一套菜单**。但保留两个入口有价值：右键适合熟练用户，“⋯”方便发现操作，也支持触控和键盘。

截图中更明显的问题是：“⋯”按钮体积太大、白底突出，抢走了联系人名称的注意力。

建议统一成：

- **同一份菜单**：右键联系人和点击“⋯”打开完全一致的操作，避免内容、状态和权限判断分叉。
- **弱化按钮**：“⋯”改为小尺寸无底色图标，仅在鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦该行时显示；触控设备保持可见。
- **统一选中反馈**：打开菜单时保持当前行高亮，关闭后焦点回到入口。
- **移除多余提示**：操作按钮不应再弹出“Ronaldo”姓名提示，应显示“更多操作”。

这样能合并操作逻辑，又保留必要的可发现性。**不建议只留右键**，否则触控和不熟悉右键的用户很难找到这些功能。

content.text:
可以实现部分能力，但**纯 PWA 目前不能通过蓝牙或 AirDrop，跨平台替代现有的自动局域网发现**。最可行的 PWA 方案是：**扫码配对＋WebRTC 传消息**。

这里要区分两件事：项目当前用 **UDP 多播发现设备**，随后通过 **Noise 加密 TCP 传消息**。替换发现入口，不一定要替换消息传输。

| 方案 | 发现附近设备 | 传消息 | 对 Mesh-Talk 的适用性 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Web Bluetooth | 用户主动选择 BLE 设备，无法让两个 PWA 对称广播、发现 | 可与原生 BLE 服务交换数据 | 适合原生桥接，不适合纯 PWA 互联 |
| AirDrop／系统分享 | 网页无法枚举附近接收者 | 用户手动分享链接、文件 | 适合交换邀请，不适合持续聊天 |
| WebRTC DataChannel | 本身不提供联系人发现 | 支持浏览器之间传输数据 | 最适合 PWA，但需额外配对机制 |
| 原生 Wi-Fi Aware | 支持附近发现、配对 | 支持设备直连 | 值得研究，但属于原生能力 |

**蓝牙为什么不行？**

Web Bluetooth 主要让网页充当客户端，连接提供 GATT 服务的 BLE 设备；网页没有对应的广播、发布 GATT 服务能力。因此，两个打开同一 PWA 的手机，不能直接互相作为蓝牙聊天节点。初次请求设备还要求用户操作并弹出设备选择器，Safari 当前也不原生支持。[Chrome 官方文档](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/capabilities/bluetooth)、[规范仓库支持状态](https://github.com/whatwg/bluetooth/blob/main/implementation-status.md)

如果另一端是 Mesh-Talk 原生程序，由它提供 BLE 服务，部分浏览器可以连接。但这会形成平台受限的桥接方案，不能覆盖 iPhone PWA。

**AirDrop 可以用来“交换邀请”，不能作为聊天通道。**

PWA 可以调用 `navigator.share()` 打开系统分享面板；系统可能提供 AirDrop 等目标。但选择目标、确认接收由系统和用户完成，网页不能控制附近设备列表，也拿不到一条可以持续收发消息的 AirDrop 连接。[Web Share 标准](https://www.w3.org/TR/web-share/)

因此可以设计“通过系统分享发送配对邀请”，不能设计成“后台通过 AirDrop 自动发现联系人并聊天”。

**真正可行的是：扫码＋WebRTC。**

两个 PWA 可以通过 WebRTC DataChannel 发送文字和文件，但建立连接前必须交换 SDP、ICE 等连接信息。交换渠道可以是本地信令服务，也可以是二维码或手动交换；**不一定需要公网服务器，但一定需要某种连接信息交换机制**。[WebRTC 官方连接流程](https://webrtc.org/getting-started/peer-connections-advanced)

需要注意：

- 扫码方案可能需要双向交换，不能假定扫描一次就完成所有协商。
- 同一局域网具备直连条件时可以不经过公网中转；访客网络隔离、防火墙等仍可能阻止连接。
- WebRTC 不能直接连接当前的 Noise TCP 监听端口，需要新增传输适配。
- 移动端后台挂起、锁屏后的连接恢复，需要单独验证，不能按桌面常驻节点设计。

浏览器确实也出现了能操作原始 TCP／UDP 的 **Direct Sockets**，但它限制在 Isolated Web Apps 等特殊上下文，普通安装到桌面的 PWA 不会因此获得这些权限。[Chrome 官方说明](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/iwa/direct-sockets)

对于这个项目，我建议分两条路线：

1. **想给现有桌面端增加多播失效时的备用入口**：优先考虑扫码／邀请导入已知节点地址与身份信息，再复用现有加密 TCP。前提是两端 IP 可达。这个方向改动较小，也保留现有协议。
2. **想支持手机免安装使用**：采用 PWA＋扫码配对＋WebRTC，或者让原生节点提供经过认证的 HTTPS／WSS 接入服务。这是新增浏览器接入能力，需要单独设计身份认证和会话生命周期。

如果目标是“**没有共同 Wi-Fi，也没有互联网，两台手机靠近就能发现并聊天**”，应研究原生 BLE／Wi-Fi Aware。Apple 的 Wi-Fi Aware 已提供无需接入点的发现、配对与连接能力，但要求原生 API、权限及受支持硬件，PWA 无法直接调用。[Apple 官方文档](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/WiFiAware)

**我的优先建议：保留 UDP 多播，先补充扫码／邀请连接作为发现层备用方案；PWA 则以 WebRTC 作为独立接入路线。** 以上是文档与架构调研结论，尚未做设备互通实测。

content.text: Bitchat 的关键确实是蓝牙：它是原生 App，每台设备同时广播自己的服务、扫描其他设备，并通过 BLE 连接传消息；中间设备还可以继续转发。它不依赖共同的 Wi-Fi。官方当前文档也显示，它已加入 Nostr 互联网回退，Android 版还列出了 Wi-Fi Aware 传输；这些要与最初的纯蓝牙模式分开看。

content.text: 对 Mesh-Talk 来说，这证明原生蓝牙可以成为可选路线。但要注意：BLE 只用来发现设备时，后续 TCP 仍要求 IP 可达；若要像 Bitchat 一样在没有共同网络时聊天，就需要同时增加 BLE 消息传输，不能只替换 UDP 发现。

查了 Bitchat 的官方仓库、白皮书和蓝牙实现。**它确实能通过蓝牙发现并聊天，关键是：它是原生 App，既实现了蓝牙发现，也实现了蓝牙消息传输和中继。** 我之前对纯 PWA 的限制判断仍然成立，但对于 Mesh-Talk 原生端，Bitchat 这条路线值得参考。

**1. 它怎么发现附近的人？**

每台设备同时承担两个角色：

- **广播者**：发布自己的 BLE 服务，让其他设备发现。
- **扫描者**：扫描附近提供同类服务的设备，建立连接。

官方代码直接创建了 Apple 的 `CBCentralManager` 和 `CBPeripheralManager`；扫描控制器调用 `scanForPeripherals`。这些都是原生 Core Bluetooth 能力。[BLEService.swift](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat/blob/main/bitchat/Services/BLE/BLEService.swift)、[BLERadioController.swift](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat/blob/main/bitchat/Services/BLE/BLERadioController.swift)

所以不需要两台手机连接同一个 Wi-Fi，也不是先通过蓝牙发现 IP 地址。

**2. 发现之后，消息也走蓝牙吗？**

是的。它通过 BLE GATT 特征的写入、通知传输数据，并在应用层增加分片、重组和转发。

例如 A 能连接 B，B 能连接 C，即使 A 无法直接连接 C，也可以由 B 转发消息。它使用 TTL、去重和随机转发延迟控制循环与重复传播。这里的 mesh 是应用自己实现的多跳网络，不应理解为手机自动加入了某种通用蓝牙路由网络。[官方协议白皮书](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat/blob/main/WHITEPAPER.md)

**3. 为什么 PWA 做不到同样的事？**

差别是平台开放的权限，而不是蓝牙技术本身。

| 能力 | Bitchat 原生 App | 普通 PWA |
|---|---|---|
| 扫描 BLE 服务 | 可以，受系统权限限制 | 部分浏览器支持用户选择设备 |
| 广播自己的 BLE 服务 | 可以 | 没有对应的通用能力 |
| 提供 GATT 服务端 | 可以 | 不支持 |
| 两个同类客户端相互发现、连接 | 可以实现 | 缺少上述服务端能力 |

Web Bluetooth 主要允许网页连接远端 GATT 服务，不能让两个 PWA 都像 Bitchat 那样同时广播和提供服务；安装成 PWA 也不会获得原生蓝牙权限。[Chrome 官方说明](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/capabilities/bluetooth)

**4. 它也有需要考虑的实际边界。**

- **后台运行有约束**：iOS 后台扫描、广播行为会改变，不能保证像前台一样及时发现；Android 版使用前台服务维持连接，仍受系统后台限制。[Apple 后台蓝牙说明](https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/NetworkingInternetWeb/Conceptual/CoreBluetooth_concepts/CoreBluetoothBackgroundProcessingForIOSApps/PerformingTasksWhileYourAppIsInTheBackground.html)、[Android 官方仓库](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat-android)
- **多跳需要中间设备参与**：不是距离无限延伸，链路断开就需要等待重连或其他递送机制。
- **私聊加密不代表所有流量私密**：官方区分私聊和公开广播，并明确讨论了广播身份的可关联性。[官方白皮书](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat/blob/main/WHITEPAPER.md)
- **当前版本已不只有蓝牙**：还包括 Nostr 互联网回退；Android 版列有 Wi-Fi Aware 高带宽传输，不能把所有功能都归因于 BLE。[官方 README](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat)、[Android README](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat-android)

对 Mesh-Talk，我建议这样理解这次调研：

| 想解决的问题 | 应增加的能力 |
|---|---|
| 同一局域网，多播被禁用 | BLE 辅助发现，后续复用现有 TCP |
| 没有共同 Wi-Fi，也没有互联网 | BLE 发现＋BLE 消息传输 |
| 希望经其他设备转发 | 再增加中继、去重、跳数和资源预算 |
| 手机免安装使用 | 仍采用 PWA＋扫码／WebRTC 路线 |

**因此，原生 BLE 可以成为 Mesh-Talk 的可选补充，而且比 AirDrop 更适合作为可编程通信通道。** 合理的第一步是验证“两台原生设备通过 BLE 发现并发送加密短消息”，先测前台、锁屏和跨平台表现，再决定是否增加多跳中继。现有身份、消息和加密协议应继续由 Mesh-Talk 自己的模块负责，不必照搬 Bitchat 的整套协议。

以上是官方文档和源码调研，尚未进行真机互通测试。

我理解你是希望继续推进蓝牙通信方案。它涉及新增传输能力、后台生命周期和跨平台支持，我会先确认范围，避免把“研究可行性”直接扩成一整套蓝牙 mesh。

# Native Bluetooth discovery and messaging — proposed first increment

## Scope
An opt-in native BLE direct-peer transport alongside existing UDP discovery and TCP delivery. Start with macOS desktop; retain portable protocol boundaries for Windows and Linux. No PWA peripheral mode, mobile application, multi-hop relay or Bitchat interoperability in this increment.

## Existing owners
`transport/channel.rs` already supports AsyncRead + AsyncWrite streams and owns Noise XX and authenticated device/account binding. `node/transport.rs` currently constructs TCP-specific channels; node delivery callers must be traced before extending that boundary. Discovery hints do not establish authenticated presence or recipient delivery. Native lifecycle must remain bound to the admitted desktop runtime.

## Proposed behavior
Off by default. Native adapter publishes a dedicated versioned service and scans for the same service. A GATT endpoint remains untrusted until the existing authenticated handshake validates its device/account identity. BLE address and RSSI are not identities. Prefer existing reachable TCP delivery; use BLE for admitted direct peers without IP connectivity. Reuse existing message acceptance, event IDs and receipt semantics; switching transport cannot duplicate durable messages or claim delivery early.

## Boundaries and budgets
OS adapter owns scanning, advertising and GATT callbacks; the core owns bounded framing, identity authentication and message semantics. BLE fragmentation must validate negotiated payload size, declared frame size, fragment order and session generation before allocation/reassembly. Bound connections, pending writes, queued bytes and reassembly lifetime; choose actual constants after OS/API capability investigation. GATT callbacks enqueue bounded work without waiting on node locks or UI dispatch. Disconnect, adapter-off, logout and runtime replacement revoke writes and terminate owned tasks; stale callbacks cannot publish presence or commit messages. Do not introduce a second crypto/session identity protocol.

## Evidence required
First verify actual macOS central/peripheral support and permissions in a packaged app. Automated regressions must cover authenticated stream compatibility, fragment errors, queue saturation, disconnect mid-frame, cancellation, stale callbacks, duplicate delivery and TCP fallback. Two physical devices must demonstrate BLE-only discovery and encrypted text delivery with IP disabled, reconnect and Bluetooth off/on. Mock adapters and successful compilation do not establish radio interoperability. Cross-platform support requires corresponding platform builds and physical-device evidence before being advertised.

## Decision pending
Confirm first supported platform and this bounded initial scope before implementation. Alternative: implement all desktop OS adapters together (larger validation matrix), or discovery only (cannot carry messages without a reachable IP path).

# Native Bluetooth transport

Native BLE is an experimental direct-link transport, separate from the released
UDP multicast discovery and TCP node runtime. It is currently a two-host macOS
rehearsal, not an enabled desktop chat feature. It does not interoperate with
Bitchat. Pure PWA peripheral support is outside this capability.

## Ownership and authentication

`transport/ble.rs` owns the bounded session-scoped chunk/byte-stream boundary.
`SecureChannel` remains the owner of Noise XX and device identity binding. Native
adapters must reserve inbound capacity before copying callback data and close a
link on budget exhaustion; callbacks must never wait for a consumer or hold node
locks. Shutdown revokes queued data as well as future callbacks. The byte stream's
flush acknowledges queue admission, not radio acknowledgment or durable delivery.

`src-tauri/examples/bluetooth-radio.swift` owns a single CoreBluetooth central or
peripheral connection for the rehearsal. GATT writes use response acknowledgment;
notifications wait for native readiness after backpressure. Chunks are at most
20 bytes. One pending outbound chunk and 64 inbound output slots bound buffering.
A dedicated stdout writer prevents a blocked consumer from freezing Bluetooth
callbacks or signal handling. Disconnect, power loss and malformed or excessive
input fail the process; the caller must start a new session to retry.

`bluetooth-rehearsal` owns the explicit process lifecycle, two-minute deadline,
pre-exchanged public-key pinning and encrypted echo. The helper sees encrypted
Noise bytes, not chat plaintext. Its process and streams are retired on failure,
Ctrl-C or completion. Test text is limited to 4096 bytes and is held in memory;
an echo is not a persisted message, account proof, read receipt or delivery claim.
Use dedicated rehearsal identities, not production account keystores.

## Two-host macOS rehearsal

Build on each host from the repository root (Xcode Command Line Tools required):

```sh
mkdir -p tmp/bluetooth
swiftc src-tauri/examples/bluetooth-radio.swift -o tmp/bluetooth/radio \
  -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist \
  -Xlinker src-tauri/examples/bluetooth-radio.plist
cargo build -p mesh-talk-core --example bluetooth-rehearsal
```

Create a private password file at `tmp/bluetooth/password` using a local editor,
then run `chmod 600 tmp/bluetooth/password`. Create and print each host's dedicated
public identity (this command does not start Bluetooth):

```sh
cargo run -p mesh-talk-core --example bluetooth-rehearsal -- \
  --keystore tmp/bluetooth/identity --password-file tmp/bluetooth/password --identity
```

Exchange the printed public keys through an authenticated out-of-band channel.
On host A, run the following with host B's key; on host B use `--role central`
and host A's key. Allow the operating system's Bluetooth permission request.

```sh
cargo run -p mesh-talk-core --example bluetooth-rehearsal -- \
  --keystore tmp/bluetooth/identity --password-file tmp/bluetooth/password \
  --radio tmp/bluetooth/radio --role peripheral --peer PEER_PUBLIC_KEYS
```

Disable IP networking while retaining Bluetooth for the BLE-only scenario. Verify
an authenticated text/echo, mismatch rejection, interruption, Bluetooth off/on,
and a fresh-process reconnect. Record the host hardware, OS, permission state,
foreground/background state and exact result. One Mac cannot establish two-host
radio evidence by connecting to its own advertisement. A typecheck or mock stream
test is not evidence of native radio behavior or absence of all deadlocks.

## Desktop integration boundary

Do not insert synthetic IP addresses into the roster or proxy BLE through a
loopback socket. Discovery is an untrusted endpoint hint, not authenticated
presence. Full node integration requires typed TCP/BLE routes and runtime
generations, common privacy admission on dial and accept, existing connection
permits, transport-aware disclosure, and receipt handling in existing owners.
TCP pooling/liveness relies on socket readiness; fresh BLE sessions must not be
pooled under approximate TCP semantics. Prefer a reachable TCP route before BLE,
within a shared bounded operation budget. Logout, disable and runtime replacement
must revoke authority and retire all adapter work before publishing a replacement.

See [network contracts](network-design-reference.md),
[module ownership](module-boundaries.md), and
[reliability rules](ai-coding-reliability.md). Mobile platforms, multi-hop relay,
background guarantees and automatic desktop routing require separate evidence.
EOF
